scientific_integrity: All finite computations are supporting checks rather than infinite proofs. The proof uses standard size-bias Poisson Stein bounds, a graph-specific coupling, and de-Poissonization. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only simple regular graphs with at least two neighbors at every vertex, independent uniform edge samples, and first-coverage of vertices; no irregular graphs or weighted/dependent samples. The graph-uniform total-variation bound is continuous-time only; the discrete-time theorem is asymptotic. Historical novelty is qualified by a residual risk of broader general coupon approximation results.
title: Universal Gumbel coverage for uniformly sampled edges of regular graphs
